comment: Deterministic services are described as producing the same result for the same input every time. Results may differ when reference data, rules, time context, or service versions change.

anchor.note: p.106 l.Lines 85-89 read as the printed page; section 5.2 agrees

public.text: Deterministic services are described as producing the same result for the same input every time. Results may differ when reference data, rules, time context, or service versions change.
public.suggestedRevision: Qualify the statement: “The same input evaluated against the same governed rule set, reference-data version, configuration, and time context should produce a reproducible result.”
